_about: Quest hubs, 17 Nov 2026: Spiritwalker Kesh stands in the troll village now, so his lines say which way to go from it.

echo_kesh_pearls.accept_text: Go south-west to the Sunken Temple Grotto, on its own isle, and follow the trail to the end inside the temple. The murlocs hoard the pearls and the elementals wear them.

echo_kesh_crypt.accept_text: He's in the Sunken Temple Grotto, south-west of here, off the west gate of the rotunda. You'll find him at the back.
